ruleset.name: ThriveDesk i18n
ruleset.description:
Translation sniffs, enforced across ALL source with no path exclusions.
A separate ruleset for the same reason phpcs-security.xml is one: phpcs.xml excludes legacy paths from the `WordPress` ref while formatting is adopted incrementally, and PHPCS keys a rule-scoped exclude by its ref string, so the `WordPress` exclusion is consulted for WordPress.WP.I18n and wins. Those excluded paths - includes/, src/Admin.php, src/Conversations/ - are where nearly every translatable string in the plugin lives, so the sniff was configured and reaching almost nothing.
Warnings fail here, unlike the security ruleset. The one warning this sniff raises is a missing "translators:" comment, and a placeholder with no explanation is a string a translator has to guess at - which is the defect, not a note about one.
Run with: composer phpcs-i18n
